step.title: Benvenuta, Nonna Maria
step.prompt: Buongiorno, Nonna Maria. È un piacere passare questo tempo insieme a te oggi.
step.promptTranslation: Good morning, Nonna Maria. It is a pleasure to spend this time with you today.
step.caregiverTip: Start with a warm, calm tone to help Nonna Maria feel settled and ready for our time together.

step.title: Roberto Murolo

entity.name: Roberto Murolo
entity.description: Italian singer and guitarist known for Neapolitan songs and classical guitar.

step.prompt: Ascoltiamo insieme Roberto Murolo, la cui voce ha accompagnato tante serate a Napoli negli anni '50. Cosa ti fa venire in mente questa musica?
step.promptTranslation: Let's listen to Roberto Murolo together, whose voice accompanied many evenings in Naples in the 1950s. What does this music bring to mind for you?
step.caregiverTip: Roberto Murolo was a staple of 1950s Naples; his guitar playing often brings back memories of the Spanish Quarter for those who grew up there.

step.title: L'oro di Napoli

entity.name: The Gold of Naples
entity.description: The Gold of Naples is an episodic 1950s Italian film directed by Vittorio De Sica, originally released in 1954 (U.S. release 1957-02-11). The film assembles six short vignettes that mix comedy and drama to portray the lives, desires and hardships of Naples' inhabitants. Its cast and collaborators include Totò, Lianella Carell, Pasquale Cennamo, with notable appearances by several major Italian performers; Carlo Ponti and Alessandro Cicognigni are referenced among production contributors. Combining neorealist social observation with warm humor and poignant tragedy, the film examines themes of…

step.prompt: Guarda questa scena tratta da L'oro di Napoli del 1954. Cosa noti in questo scorcio della nostra città?
step.promptTranslation: Look at this scene from The Gold of Naples from 1954. What do you notice in this glimpse of our city?
followUps: Cosa ti piace di più di questa immagine?
step.caregiverTip: The Gold of Naples captures the spirit of 1950s Naples perfectly; focus on the familiar streets or the atmosphere rather than the plot.
step.mediaHint: Search 'The Gold of Naples 1954' on YouTube

step.title: Frank Sinatra

entity.name: Frank Sinatra
entity.description: Iconic American singer and actor known for his smooth voice and timeless classics.

step.prompt: Ascoltiamo un classico di Frank Sinatra, molto amato negli anni '60. Ti va di ascoltare insieme?
step.promptTranslation: Let's listen to a Frank Sinatra classic, very popular in the 1960s. Would you like to listen together?
step.caregiverTip: Frank Sinatra was a global icon in the 1960s; many people from Naples enjoyed his smooth style during that decade.

step.title: Il ragù della domenica
step.prompt: Il profumo del ragù della domenica è un ricordo speciale. Raccontami come preparavi il tuo ragù negli anni '50.
step.promptTranslation: The scent of Sunday ragù is a special memory. Tell me how you used to prepare your ragù in the 1950s.
followUps: Qual era il tuo segreto per un buon sugo?
step.caregiverTip: Sunday ragù is a core memory for many from Naples; focus on the sensory experience of the kitchen in the 1950s.

step.title: Grazie, Nonna Maria
step.prompt: Grazie per aver condiviso questi ricordi con me, Nonna Maria. È stato bellissimo stare insieme.
step.promptTranslation: Thank you for sharing these memories with me, Nonna Maria. It was wonderful to be together.
step.caregiverTip: End with a gentle touch or a warm smile to conclude the session on a positive note.
